sketch:
Observe: SVG balance à plateaux; student drags masses marquées onto
one pan and a sample onto the other, watches the beam tilt with an
inverse-pendulum tween until equilibrium. HUD shows the reading in
g / kg. Experiment: measure three samples to a target precision,
choosing the mass set that makes the fewest weighings. Evaluate:
given a target mass, student picks the smallest subset of standard
masses that sums to it (small combinatorial puzzle). Wrinkle:
unit-conversion HUD between mg/g/kg/t. Possibly merged with
proprietes-matiere.
